about: What the code states in one section about another, which a regular expression should not guess. Each entry quotes the words it rests on; build.py checks the quote is in the source provision and the date is in the quote. Added by CC, 2026-10-31; provisional until a person confirms.

zones.name: Moderate Density Residential-24
zones.quote: The Moderate Density Residential District-24 is primarily intended for middle housing and multi-family housing at a maximum net density of 24.2 units per acre and a minimum net density of 12.1 units per acre

operative.quote: sections 8 and 9, chapter 330, Oregon Laws 2025, by sections 5 to 13 of this 2026 Act become operative on January 1, 2028
operative.reading: Section 12 of 2026 c.79 amends section 8, chapter 330, Oregon Laws 2025, and lies within sections 5 to 13; so the amended text is operative on 2028-01-01, a year after the Act's effective date.
